name: Tatsuki Haruyoshi
source:
Same as Yutaka, he was also an underling of Ginji. Is in an argument with his wife who left their house, and is currently freeloading in Yutaka's house together with his foster son Jun while waiting for her to calm down. Is a womanizer, and is good at bed. After Ginji died, he's aiming for Sayoko. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.alicesoft.com/tsumamigui3/chara/sub.html]Official Site[/url]]
